findings.summary: The Save affordance now requires a nonblank birthday, but the birthday is declared optional everywhere else.
findings.evidence: preconditions: [Owner session, Nonblank name, Nonblank birthday] vs. 'Optional birthday as month and day', 'an optional month-day birthday' and J.contacts s4 'save, name nonblank'

findings.summary: The birthday field is typed as a full local-date, but the UI and criterion define it as a month-day value whose year may be left blank.
findings.evidence: { name: birthday, type: local-date, optional: true } vs. 'Optional birthday as month and day; the year may be left blank'

findings.summary: The operation and its hook fixture were not updated for birthday validation, so the new criterion claim has no matching operation contract or executable evidence.
findings.evidence: operation.contact.save preconditions: [Owner session, Nonblank name]; hook fixture: "blank name rejected, input preserved on failure, owned record saved"
